About the role
 

At Leviat Belgium, we are currently looking for an ambitious & enthusiastic 
 Civil Engineer-Architect for our Technical Office based in 
Ternat.
 

Are you a recent industrial science/architecture grad? Eager to innovate and design? Keep on reading!
 

Main responsibilities:
 

In this role you'll:
 
 

• Lead Projects: 
Own projects from design to execution, crafting custom solutions. 

• Provide expert insights: 
Analyze and offer optimal designs that exceed client needs. 

• Engage with contractors, architects, and team members to ensure project success. 

• Create accurate and prompt engineering quotes. 

• Collaborate with colleagues and the wider sales teams to ensure project success.  

 
 

Experience required:
 

To be successful in this role you'll need:
 
 

• A Master's degree in 
industrial sciences/architecture or relevant technical experience 

• A keen interest in construction and design innovation. 

• To be proficient in MS Office, Autocad, or similar tools. 

• To be trilingual in Dutch, French and English.  

 
 

Leviat is an equal opportunities employer. We are commited to creating an inclusive work environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
 

Please note that we cannot accept any applications submitted through email for GDPR purposes. Candidates must apply through our job portal. We do not accept candidate introductions for this position from recruitment agencies, unless you have been instructed to do so by our recruitment team.

 

• A Master's degree in 
industrial sciences/architecture or relevant technical experience 

• A keen interest in construction and design innovation. 

• To be proficient in MS Office, Autocad, BIM or similar tools. 

• Speak Dutch and French

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES
 

Support the team to organise workshops and events,
 

Prepare meetings and events material,
 

Take care of communication actions, updating websites, registrations, newsletters, etc.
 

Support team members to fulfil the association's role in the EU-funded projects (timesheets, drafting and submitting reports, etc.).
 

Archiving documents, updating CRM, and other administration tasks.
 

Support the team in other ad-hoc assignments related to the day-to-day activities of the association. 

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS 
 

Degree in communication, administration, project management or related studies. 
 

Experience in a similar position.
 

Should be able to work autonomously with little supervision.
 

Should be well organised, flexible and open-minded. 
 

Should be able to set priorities, follow strict deadlines, be proactive 
 

Should have good IT skills (Outlook, Office 365) and communication tools knowledge & understanding 
 

Knowledge and experience within the European context in Brussels would be highly considered. 
 

Very good writing and communication skills and a sense of diplomacy. 
 

Excellent spoken and written English.

Our client is a leading professional services organization operating a network of accounting and advisory offices across Belgium. Driven by strong growth ambitions and a continuous focus on innovation, the company has invested significantly in digital transformation, process excellence, and modern technologies to support both its employees and clients.As part of its long-term strategy, the company is building a future-oriented environment where technology and people work hand in hand. The Digital Team plays a key role in this journey by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, standardize ways of working, and unlock the potential of emerging technologies across the business.To support this journey, they are seeking a Digital & Process Expert (AI) to play a key role in shaping and delivering their digital transformation initiatives.

As a Digital Expert, you will play a central role in shaping and accelerating the organization's digital and AI transformation agenda.Your responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing existing business processes across accounting offices and identifying opportunities for optimization, standardization, and automation.
• Defining future-state processes and selecting the most appropriate technologies to support them.
• Driving the adoption of digital tools such as accounting, reporting, workflow, and collaboration platforms.
• Identifying and implementing AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, reduce manual work, and improve service quality.
• Monitoring emerging trends in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, automation, and digital innovation, and translating these into concrete business opportunities.
• Designing and coordinating change management and implementation strategies for large-scale transformation projects.
• Acting as a trusted advisor to management and business stakeholders regarding digitalization initiatives and process improvements.
• Collaborating closely with key users and local offices to ensure successful adoption of new technologies.
• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives through feedback collection, process reviews, and performance monitoring.
• Building and facilitating internal communities to share best practices, success stories, and knowledge related to digital tools and AI applications.
• Serving as the link between operational teams, leadership, and technology partners to ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable business value.
This position combines business analysis, process improvement, technology consulting, AI enablement, and change management in a highly visible role.

Profile

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with a genuine passion for technology, digital innovation, and Artificial Intelligence.You are likely to bring:

• Several years of experience in a digital transformation, business analysis, process improvement, consulting, or change management role.
• A solid understanding of accounting workflows, financial processes, or professional services environments. Experience within accountancy is considered a strong asset.
• A strong interest in AI technologies and their practical application in business environments.
• Experience working with digital platforms, workflow tools, automation solutions, or business software ecosystems.
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to identify inefficiencies and translate complex challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to engage users at all levels of the organization.
• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, balancing long-term strategic objectives with short-term business needs.
• The ability to explain complex technological concepts, including AI-related topics, in a simple and accessible manner.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.
• Willingness to travel regularly to various offices and work closely with local teams.
• Professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with French considered a valuable asset.
Most importantly, you enjoy helping people embrace change and are motivated by the opportunity to make technology and AI create tangible business impact.

Business Analyst (Junior or Senior) — Ghent
 

Are you ready to learn fast and make a real impact, working side by side with a small, close-knit team in Ghent? At Corlutions, we've been helping companies grow with Odoo since 2019, and we're expanding our team to do even more of that.
 

 
 

About Corlutions
 

Corlutions is a digitalization partner for small and medium-sized enterprises, specializing in Odoo-based solutions that help organizations reduce costs and increase revenue. We work closely with clients across sectors like manufacturing, construction, wholesale, and finance — always living by our principle: "Together is better."
 

 
 

What is a Business Analyst at Corlutions?
 

As a Business Analyst, your mission is to help our clients optimize their business processes through smart, well-implemented software — primarily Odoo and Business Intelligence. You'll gather and document business requirements, and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide every project.
 

You'll work closely with clients to ensure optimal use of Odoo apps such as Accounting, Point of Sales, eCommerce, Manufacturing, Inventory, Projects, Websites, Sales and more. By diving into your client's needs and processes, and providing personalized training, you'll become the go-to expert for their management solutions.
 

In your first weeks, you'll get comprehensive training before jumping into your first projects — always with the support of your mentor and colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gain autonomy too. Collaboration stays key throughout: you'll be in regular contact with clients, developers, and the internal team.
 

 
 

Responsibilities
 

Project Implementation (80%)
 
 

• Gain the trust of your customers 

• Analyse needs, gather and document requirements, and suggest and implement solutions (configuration, development and testing) 

• Provide training 

• Follow-up and communication about ongoing tasks  

Internal improvement (20%)
 
 

• Feedback to the internal team 

• Mentoring and training 

• Feedback for improvement  

Optional: support other domains such as marketing, HR and accounting at Corlutions (impacts the % split above).
 

 
 

What's great about the job?
 

Expect real responsibility from day one, in a friendly and open environment where you'll work both independently and collaboratively. You'll take on a variety of projects across different industries, broadening your experience along the way. As a bonus, you'll go through an in-depth training provided by Odoo.
 

 
 

What we offer
 
 

• Sponsored events — afterworks and team buildings 

• Trainings — a real learning and development program 

• Green coworking space — we work from Pentagon, a green coworking space surrounded by water in Ghent 

• Sport activity — play any sport with colleagues, the bill might be covered! 

• Eat & drink — fruit basket and coffee on the house  

 
 

Ready to start your adventure? Apply now

Must Have
 
 

• Bachelor or Master's degree 

• Fluent in English and Dutch 

• Strong analytical mindset, with an interest in business analysis 

• Good communication and negotiation skills 

• Autonomous, assertive & proactive 

• Affinity with the IT world, and interest in Odoo, ERP and Business Intelligence tools 

• Learn fast and have a "Can Do" attitude  

Nice to Have
 
 

• Background in Business Administration, Applied Economics, Civil Engineering, Computer Sciences, or Business Intelligence experience 

• Fluent in French 

• Experience across different domains (marketing, HR, accounting) is a plus 

• Technical knowledge (XML, Python, JS, SQL, programming)

Our client is an FMCG player active in household products and based in Walloon Brabant.

They are looking for a sales support in their KAM team to support the Sales Manager and the sales team for the Retailers Lidl & Aldi.

Description

As a Sales Support German/English your responsibilities are:

• You will coordinate client projects and queries
• You will support the sales team in offers and tenders

International Operations Manager - UK
The International Operations Manager - UK is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the company's overall business operations in the UK market, including retail operations, people management, B2B and B2C sales, marketing, events, inventory, budgeting, compliance and business development.

The role ensures the stable, efficient and compliant operation of the UK business while supporting sustainable sales growth, market development and the expansion of the company's K-beauty activities in line with its European and global strategy.
Key Responsibilities
• Oversee the operation of stores, showrooms, pop-up locations and other offline sales channels in the UK, ensuring operational standards, service quality and customer experience.
• Manage local staffing, including recruitment, onboarding, training, work allocation, scheduling and performance follow-up.
• Develop and implement B2B and B2C sales strategies and identify new distributors, retailers, commercial partners and business opportunities in the UK market.
• Maintain and develop relationships with existing clients, distributors and strategic partners.
• Develop and implement annual and quarterly commercial and marketing plans in coordination with the European organisation and Korean headquarters.
• Plan and execute promotional campaigns, trade fairs, pop-up stores, customer events and partner events, including budget, logistics and performance evaluation.
• Conduct market research and monitor competitors, consumer trends, pricing, distribution developments and K-beauty market opportunities.
• Set sales targets and KPIs, monitor commercial performance and prepare regular management reports and recommendations.
• Analyse sales results, customer feedback and market developments and implement actions to improve business performance.
• Prepare and manage operating budgets, monitor expenses and identify opportunities to improve profitability and cost efficiency.
• Manage sales forecasts, ordering, stock levels, logistics and inventory flow to ensure appropriate product availability.
• Monitor legal, administrative and regulatory requirements applicable to UK operations, including product sales, cosmetics, retail, employment and consumer protection.
• Coordinate with external advisers, service providers, suppliers and relevant authorities and monitor the quality and delivery of their services.
• Identify key operational, commercial and regulatory risks and report significant matters to senior management.
• Work closely with the Korean headquarters, the European entity and other country teams to align UK operations with the company's regional and global strategy.
• Develop and implement initiatives to improve operational efficiency, profitability, market presence and long-term business growth.
• Act as the main operational point of coordination for the UK market and support management in strategic and commercial decision-making. Candidate Profile
We are looking for a candidate with strong international business awareness and practical experience who can manage business operations, sales, marketing and K-beauty-related activities in the UK market in an integrated manner.

This position requires continuous communication and coordination between the Korean headquarters and the UK and European teams. The successful candidate should therefore combine a strong understanding of the K-beauty industry with practical capabilities in business development, marketing and operations.
Essential Requirements
• Very high level of Korean proficiency, sufficient to conduct business discussions with the Korean headquarters, prepare reports and documents, and manage day-to-day business communication effectively
• Advanced business English proficiency, sufficient to conduct meetings, negotiations and operational coordination with UK-based employees, clients and business partners
• Proven experience conducting business meetings with English-speaking stakeholders, partners and local employees, including preparing meeting minutes and business reports in English
• Degree or professional education in Economics, Business Administration, Media Technology, Digital Content, Cultural Content or a related field
• Relevant professional experience in marketing, business development, brand management, sales or a related area
• Professional experience in overseas K-beauty markets, including brand marketing, distribution, sales or business development
• Practical experience using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), or relevant certification, with the ability to analyse and report on website traffic, conversions and marketing performance
• Practical understanding of B2B and B2C business models and distribution structures
• Experience planning and managing online and offline marketing campaigns, promotions or events
• Ability to update website content and manage basic website operations
• Ability to conduct market research, competitor analysis, consumer trend analysis and identify new business opportunities
• Ability to analyse sales and marketing data and propose actions to improve business performance
• Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with headquarters, local employees, external partners, suppliers and service providersPreferred Qualifications
• Experience living, studying or working in Korea, with an understanding of Korean business culture and working practices
• Experience in business, marketing, distribution, sales or brand operations in the UK or European market
• Experience participating in K-culture or K-content-related projects, such as international film festivals
• Experience supporting the international expansion, localisation or overseas marketing of Korean brands or Korean consumer products
• Qualification or practical experience in video production or video editing
• Understanding of and practical ability to work with photography, video, social media and digital content
• Experience using CMS or other website management systems
• Proficiency in additional foreign languages beyond Korean and English
• Experience working in multicultural and international business environmentsKey Competencies
The successful candidate should understand the business and cultural differences between Korea and the UK/European markets and be able to effectively adapt the Korean headquarters' business strategy and brand direction to local market conditions.

The candidate should also be able to connect sales, marketing, partner management and business operations through a strong understanding of the K-beauty industry and local consumer market, contributing to market expansion, revenue growth and the stable operation of the company's UK business.

Position overview:
 

The role supports the EHS Manager to ensure and safeguard environmental, health and safety (EHS) aspects, fire safety and property protection (FSPP) sustainability programmes to ensure the safety and well-being of all workers and protection of the environment. Also he/she will provide advice and guidance to plant management on EHS, FSPP, and any other safety, health, well-being issues. Safety Advisor will support EHS Manager with daily management of EHS and FSPP risks to ensure the plant meets it compliance obligations and Ball requirements and implements best practice. The job position helps coordinate EHS activity.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Point of contact for the external service personnel responsible for psychosocial aspects, occupational hygiene, ergonomics, and occupational medicine. 

• Assist in the identification of hazards. Provide advice on appropriate risks and propose possible (preventive) measures. 

• Provide training within the framework of a stable safety culture. 

• Provide advice and proposals regarding the purchase of work equipment, PPE, and the layout of workplaces. 

• Drafting the Annual Action Plan and the Global Prevention Plan. Maintaining records regarding occupational accidents and reporting them. Implementing the annual action plan. 

• Investigating workstations, conducting a thorough, in-depth examination of the workplaces and workstations. 

• Drafting safety instructions. 

• Providing advice and supervision regarding fire prevention. 

• Identifying, relevant, and inventorying risks. Supporting solutions and their implementation. 

• Objectively document and record on-site findings in a report. Collect additional information useful for the report. 

• Handle the administrative follow-up of the execution of assignments and decisions made. Gather and classify all documents in the file. Prepare reports in accordance with regulations. 

• Prepare risk analyses and job description sheets. 

• Organize medical examinations in collaboration with the external service.  

 
 

What Are We Looking For?
 
 

• Level I or II Prevention Advisor certification. 

• Experience of min 2-3 years as Safety Advisor. 

• Experience in industry. 

• Fluent English and Dutch.

Job Description:

As a Future Finance Talents Internship (FFTI) participant, you will be working alongside experienced finance professionals, contributing to various financial projects and gaining insights into the financial operations of a leading global brewing company. You will play a key role in delivering the main financial products of a Fast Moving Consumer Goods company that impact the company's performance. In 2025, FFTIs converted into full time hires and graduate trainees.

These work experiences will be located in Leuven.

Finance Areas You Could Be Matched With:

• Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A): Our Belgium, BNFL, and Zone Europe HQ hosts a high-performance FP&A team responsible for budgeting, forecasting, and enabling dynamic resource allocation to help deliver our operational and financial objectives.
• Accounting: We deliver a robust, timely set of financials on a monthly basis. Connect across our European Zone to help us manage by exception and automate our monthly and quarterly routines.
• Internal Audit: Jump into the beating heart of an on-going process or financial audit with our Global Risk Management team. Learn how the world's largest brewer runs from the inside out.
• Treasury: Work with our Global Treasury team based in Leuven to understand how we manage our derivatives, cash, and loan portfolio.
In all roles:

• Work-Experience Cohort: Our Future Finance Talent Internships are connected with one another to help create a strong network of young professionals. You will be integrated into operating teams and will therefore be able to leverage from operating team's experience.
• Weekly Masterclass: Regardless of your work-experience area, receive a master-class training from the functional lead of each area to ensure a broad-based understanding of Finance in a Fast Moving Consumer Goods company. (FP&A, Control, Tax, Sales Finance, M&A, Internal Audit, General Management)
• Capstone in Leuven: We will regroup as a full Cohort in Leuven to further cement learnings and ensure a strong network.
Skill-sets you will acquire:

• Data Management: Work with large data sets and support in improving financial reporting systems, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
• Process Improvement: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize financial processes and ensure best practices in reporting and analysis.
• Cost & Margin Analysis: Analyze production costs, profitability, and gross margins to provide actionable insights.
• Ad Hoc Projects: Participate in various financial projects, including internal audits, cost optimization initiatives, or strategy development.
• Collaboration: Work closely with finance teams in other departments (e.g., operations, marketing, sales) to gather data and insights relevant to financial performance. 
Who We're Looking For:

• Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field. You should be interning before your final year of studies.
• Timing: Academic year Summer 2027
• Languages: you are Fluent in Dutch and/or French and have a good knowledge of English. Other languages are a plus!
• Work Authorization: You are eligible to work in Belgium without the need of a work-permit.
• Skills:
• Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
• Proficiency in process mapping or financial modeling.
•  Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
Experience:

• Previous internship in finance or accounting is an advantage but not mandatory.
• FFTI is an academic component of your education and is considered an unpaid work experience.
What happens next?

Step 1: Online ApplicationSubmit your application online to get started.

Step 2: Video AssessmentKeep an eye on your inbox for an invitation to complete a short video assessment

Are you an experienced CNC operator looking for a new challenge? We urgently need skilled professionals to join our team at our brand-new machine shop! 

Our workshop has moved to a location 10 times larger with many more machines, and we’re looking for enthusiastic people to help us grow!

• Experience in CNC programming, turning, and milling (if you only have turning experience, we have options, but milling experience alone is not sufficient).

• Experience with 5-axis machines and knowledge of more than 3-axis operations.

• Familiarity with Fanuc, Siemens, and Mazatrol Smooth.

• English is sufficient for communication in our workshop.

• Willingness to work in Day shift. We are open to considering day shifts.

• 95% of programming happens at the machine using dialog control (ShopMill and ShopTurn, Siemens 840D Solution Line).

• You must have a good understanding of G- and M-codes.
